minutes.headline: Planning Board continued the citizen event-use zoning article hearing to April 29 and sought Town Counsel advice.
minutes.summary: The board approved two ANR plans, heard Unitil's proposed tree-clearing program on scenic roads, and held public hearings on zoning articles for Town Meeting. It recommended approval of the rezoning for four parcels, the cluster bylaw and the marijuana bylaws, and disapproval of the solar special-permit transfer. After heavy neighbor opposition it continued the exhibition and workshop hearing to April 29. It also discussed building reuse, an economic development committee, stormwater funding and traffic counts.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board continued the hearing on the exhibition and workshop use zoning article to April 29 after heavy neighbor opposition, and sought Town Counsel's opinion.
The planning director is to send the building commissioner's letter out and seek a Town Counsel opinion on the exhibition article.
The board voted to recommend approval of the four-parcel rezoning article, the cluster development article and the marijuana bylaw articles for Town Meeting.
The board voted to recommend disapproval of the article moving solar special permit authority to the Zoning Board of Appeals.
The board approved two ANR plans and heard Unitil's tree-clearing proposal for scenic roads, with a map mark-up and site walk planned for early May.

why_it_matters: The exhibition and workshop article would apply town-wide, so it could change what events are allowed in residential neighborhoods, and it is still undecided.
The board's recommendations go to Town Meeting, where voters will be asked to decide on the rezoning, cluster, marijuana and solar permit articles.
Stormwater is paid from general funds, mostly taxes, and the amounts are rising. A utility fee based on impervious area was explained as one way to fund it.
watch_next: April 29: the continued Planning Board hearing on the exhibition and workshop use article, and the Town Counsel opinion.
Early May: the Unitil map mark-up and site walk on scenic roads, before any hearing.
